observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a Toyota pickup with TRD-style grille/bumper and fog lights; headlights are on/reflecting.
Photo 1 shows the front-left angle; the grille and headlamp design match a Toyota Tacoma.
Photo 2 shows the rear of the same pickup; the tailgate has a visible 'V6' badge and 'Tacoma' badging area.

identity.model: Tacoma (TRD 4x4 implied by seller text; not fully verifiable from photos)

claims.claim: foreign used 2024 toyota tocoma trd 4x4 with v6 engine
claims.evidence: Photos show a Toyota Tacoma and a V6 badge (photo 2), but the model year (2024) and TRD 4x4 trim are not clearly readable in the provided photos.
No photo shows the key/fob or dashboard start button.
No photo shows the roof/glass panel or interior headliner.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Photos show exterior condition, but cannot confirm accident history, repairs, or whether the vehicle has been opened/engine bay work.
No running video, dashboard warning check, OBD scan, or test-drive evidence.

risks.risk: Model year (2024) may be different from what’s claimed; year affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the dashboard VIN/year plate or the vehicle registration/inspection document showing year (or a clear VIN plate photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed year (worst case: treat as older/unknown year within Tacoma range).

risks.risk: Trim/4x4/engine variant may not match TRD 4x4 claim; photos only confirm V6 badge area, not TRD 4x4 specifics.
risks.proof: Photo of the TRD badge/trim label (if present) and drivetrain/4WD selector area, plus VIN decode or spec sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as V6 Tacoma with trim/4x4 not confirmed (worst case: not TRD/4x4).

risks.risk: Push-to-start and moonroof may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Interior photos showing the push-button start and roof/moonroof controls or a video opening/closing the moonroof.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no confirmed push-to-start/moonroof (worst case: features not present).

risks.risk: Duty status may be unverified; could be incomplete/incorrect paperwork leading to import issues.
risks.proof: Clear photos/scans of duty payment/clearance documents (customs release, duty receipt, and any verification stamp).
risks.if_unproven: Price as duty not verified (worst case: buyer may need to regularize).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition may not be perfect (hidden faults, accident repairs, transmission/4WD issues).
risks.proof: Cold-start video + dashboard warning lights check + OBD scan report + undercarriage inspection photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needs inspection/possible faults (worst case: not guaranteed working perfectly).

risks.risk: Accident/repair history not visible from exterior photos (panel gaps, repainting, frame damage).
risks.proof: Body panel thickness/paint meter readings or close-up photos of panel gaps + frame/underbody photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible repaint/repair risk (worst case: treat as not confirmed accident-free).

proof_requests: VIN plate photo (dashboard or door jamb) and a document showing the exact model year (2024).
Photo of TRD/4x4 identifiers and the 4WD selector/controls (plus VIN decode/spec sheet).
Interior photos: push-button start area and roof/moonroof controls; short video demonstrating moonroof operation.
Cold-start video, OBD scan results, and undercarriage/frame inspection photos.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Toyota Tacoma with a V6 badge, but key value drivers and the seller’s major claims (2024 year, TRD 4x4, push-to-start, moonroof, verified duty, and “works perfectly”) are not provable from the provided images. Without those proofs, pricing would be guesswork.
